title: Drop and Cipher
author: Emrys Halloran
blurb: Juniper Dravenmoor, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
